My name is Isabela Zeberio (she/her), a social scientist with a passion for exploring identities, cultural evolution, and human interactions through computational methodology.

**Research focus.** I am a fourth-year PhD candidate at the University of Amsterdam, actively involved in the [EUDENTIFY](https://www.eudentify.org/) research project, which studies the long-term trends and causal mechanisms in the link between European Union institution building and European identity formation.

**Background.** I hold a background in Political Science and International Studies and a Master's degree in Computational Social Science from the University Carlos III of Madrid.

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:i.zeberioaguerrevere@uva.nl) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
